item.title: Mangayomi v0.9.6
item.description:
Mangayomi 0.9.6 | Mangayomi-v0.9.6-ios
# What's New
## 📖 Reader & Manga
* **Intelligent Double-Page Spreads & RTL Reading** (#1018, #1008): * Wide and landscape double-page spreads are now shown seamlessly on their own full-width screen instead of being awkwardly paired with single pages. * Switching between single and double-page view, rotating your device, or changing reading modes no longer resets your progress back to chapter 1. * Resuming chapters in Right-to-Left (manga) reading mode now starts in the correct direction without layout flipping. * **Instant Border Cropping & Cache Improvements**: * Turning border crop on or off in Webtoon / continuous reading now applies instantly without re-downloading the images. * Fixed an issue where resuming a chapter at a saved page could cause an infinite loading spinner for already cached images. * **Smoother Reading Experience**: * Fixed page flickering and display glitches when scrolling quickly through continuous chapters.
---
## Novel Reader
* **Scroll-Free E-Reader Paged Mode** (#1019): * Read novels like a real book with page-turning swipes and taps instead of endless vertical scrolling. * Quickly switch between **Continuous Scroll** and **Paged Reading** directly from the novel settings sheet. * **Single & Double-Page Column Layouts** (#1019): * Added single-page and side-by-side double-page reading modes, optimized for tablets, foldable devices, and landscape screens. * Settings sheet changes (reading mode, page mode) are now applied and previewed instantly.
---
## Video Player & Anime
* **Player Screen Lock (Mobile)**: * Added a dedicated screen lock button to the mobile controls to prevent accidental touches while watching. * When locked, all on-screen controls, touch gestures (swiping to seek, volume/brightness, double-tap jump, 2x speed hold), and the skip button are completely disabled. * Protects against accidentally exiting the player with the back button or back gesture. * Tap anywhere on the locked screen to display a quick-unlock button in the top-left corner. * **Cleaner Seek Indicator**: * Simplified and streamlined the swipe-to-seek visual overlay on the player.
---
## Features & User Experience
* **Smoother Category Management**: * Reordering categories in settings is now much more responsive and intuitive using dedicated drag handles. * **Details Header Polish**: * Improved visual layout and formatting in the manga/anime details header.
---
## Fixes & Stability
* **Reliable Background Sync**: * Fixed occasional crashes and errors that could occur when closing screens or navigating away during library synchronization.
---
## Localization
* Added translations for the new player screen lock feature across all supported languages.
---
## Contributors
* @kodjodevf * @jikkun (#1018, #1019)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.5...v0.9.6

item.title: Mangayomi v0.9.5
item.description:
Mangayomi 0.9.5 | Mangayomi-v0.9.5-ios
## What's Changed
## Reader & Novels
* **Smart Double-Page Mode** (#1008): * Automatically switch to double-page view based on screen orientation (landscape/portrait). * Chapter transition pages now remain isolated for a natural, seamless reading experience. * **Complete Novel Reader Overhaul** (#1014): * Added double-page reading mode support for novels. * Added a **Keep screen on** toggle to prevent the display from turning off while reading (#1014). * Added smooth auto-scroll with fine-tuned speed controls. * Redesigned Novel bottom bar and settings sheets: more compact, with quick font-size adjustments. * Centralized all novel settings under **More > Settings > Novel Reader** (#1014). * **Smooth Webtoon Scrolling**: * Much smoother continuous scrolling without stutter or layout jumps. * Fluid auto-scroll that reacts instantly to touch and drag gestures. * **Reliable Page Error Recovery**: * The **Retry** button is now immediately clickable with no menu overlay interference. * Added a manual **Refresh** button in the reader top bar to re-fetch fresh pages from the source. * **Dedicated Page Cache**: * Redesigned chapter caching system (100 MB disk limit with automatic cleanup of older files) to save storage and speed up loading times.
---
## Features & User Experience
* **Quick Resume from History** (#1005): * Double-tap or double-click the **History** icon in the navigation bar to instantly jump straight back into your latest read chapter or watched episode (filtered by Manga, Anime, or Novel). * **One-Tap Global Search**: * Tap any title in the entry details header to immediately search for it across all extensions (long-press continues to copy to clipboard). * Warns you before adding an entry that is already in your library. * **Customizable Chapter Swipe Actions** (#1005): * Configure left and right swipe gestures for chapters in Reader settings (Mark as Read/Unread, Bookmark, Download, or Disable). * **Mass Migration from Library** (#1005): * Added a dedicated shortcut button in the multi-select bottom action bar to quickly migrate multiple selected entries at once. * **Automatic Sync** (#1012): * Added background auto-sync support and improved sync preference handling.
---
## Video Player & Desktop
* **Desktop Controls & Performance** (#1015): * Eliminated stutter caused by mouse hover on the player controls. * Added a setting to toggle hardware acceleration on Windows. * **Audio & Subtitle Tracks**: * Better track synchronization, duplicate removal, and cleaner track labels.
---
## Localization
* Fully updated and completed translations across **17 languages** (French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and more).
---
## Fixes & Stability
* Fixed visual layout overflow issues in settings sheets and bottom bars (#1014). * Improved error handling and reliability for Kitsu discovery (#1011). * File picker improvements and stability updates (#1010).
---
## Contributors
* @kodjodevf * @NBA2K1 (#1010, #1011) * @not-akari
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.4...v0.9.5

item.title: EscapeOS v0.1.6
item.description:
EscapeOS 0.1.6 | EscapeOS-0.1.6
## EscapeOS 0.1.6
v0.1.0, v0.1.1, v0.1.3, v0.1.4, and v0.1.5 are unchanged.
### Changed - **Import from Files** asks Replace, Keep Both, or Cancel when that name is already in the folder, instead of silently writing `foo 2.txt`. Replace overwrites the existing file at the same path and name ([#2](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/2)). - A same-named **folder** is not replaced with a file; Keep Both lands beside it.
Theos arm64 IPA (iPhoneOS 16.5 SDK, `MinimumOSVersion` 18.0), same build path as 0.1.5. After install, reconnect LocalDevVPN if the list is empty; iPASide places `pairingFile.plist` again after sideload.
`EscapeOS-0.1.6.ipa` SHA-256:
``` 234b2f0dc379fc4ea818eeff6f712edbe9e7d6d63d614ea74c7b717ecc73bbf2 ```
